name: Sidebar heading
description: A heading in a sidebar, from h1 to h6. It's smaller than a heading in the main content, and always sans serif, even on pages with serif or mixed headings. Its spacing is the same as a heading's. Text colors come from the background, so they aren't part of it.
sources: az-digital/az_quickstart#6076: sidebar headings go back to their earlier sizes, and stay sans serif

level.description: The heading's level. Every heading has one.

h1.description: A level 1 sidebar heading. Below the xl breakpoint (1200px) its size scales down with the screen width.

font.size.$description: Sidebar h1 text size from the xl breakpoint (1200px) up.

h2.description: A level 2 sidebar heading. Below the xl breakpoint (1200px) its size scales down with the screen width.

font.size.$description: Sidebar h2 text size from the xl breakpoint (1200px) up.

h3.description: A level 3 sidebar heading. Below the xl breakpoint (1200px) its size scales down with the screen width.

font.size.$description: Sidebar h3 text size from the xl breakpoint (1200px) up.

h4.description: A level 4 sidebar heading. Below the xl breakpoint (1200px) its size scales down with the screen width.

font.size.$description: Sidebar h4 text size from the xl breakpoint (1200px) up.

h5.description: A level 5 sidebar heading. The same size at every screen width.

h6.description: A level 6 sidebar heading. The same size at every screen width.
